scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run fastapi dev backend/src/ong_gabriel_api/main.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload-dir backend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.format: pnpm run format:api && pnpm run format:web
scripts.format:api: uv run ruff check --fix && uv run ruff format
